Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical factual error in Step 1 by incorrectly identifying Norris Bradbury as the director of the Los Alamos Laboratory during the development of the first atomic bomb. The Planner's reasoning stated, "Given Water Boiler places us at Los Alamos, and the first atomic bomb was in 1945, the lab director in 1945 (Norris Bradbury) directed the project." This is historically inaccurate; J. Robert Oppenheimer was the director of Los Alamos from 1942 to 1945, while Norris Bradbury only became director in 1946. This premature and incorrect conclusion led to a cycle of redundant searches and confusion, as the Planner later had to backtrack and correct this specific error in Step 3. The error stemmed from a failure to verify the timeline of leadership changes at Los Alamos before drawing a conclusion, relying instead on a superficial association with the year 1945.
